title: Panel
description: Discriminated panel response — `type` selects the shape of `config`.

ownerId.description: The panel owner's user id. Omitted (HEL-1197) from the anonymous / share-token-only `GET /api/dashboards/:id/panels` wire; every authenticated producer still emits it.

dataAsOf.description: ISO-8601 timestamp of the most recent pipeline run that wrote to this panel's bound DataType; null when unbound or never run.

layout.description: Decision-15 server-owned default grid placement (HEL-909) — present on the create responses (`POST /api/panels` for every panel kind, each item of `POST /api/panels/batch`, `POST /api/panels/:id/duplicate`) as the lg item; absent/null everywhere else (layout otherwise lives on the dashboard's own `layout` field).

layouts.description: Authoritative per-breakpoint placement (HEL-1071, HEL-1260) — the item the server stored in EACH of lg/md/sm/xs when it created the panel; present on the `POST /api/panels` response (every panel kind), on every item of a `POST /api/panels/batch` response, and on a `POST /api/panels/:id/duplicate` response. Each is placed at x=0 below that breakpoint's own existing items, so it can never overlap: an `output` panel at its Output kind's default size scaled to the breakpoint's column count, any other kind at 4/4/3/2 columns by 5 rows, a duplicate at its source's size. `layout` above is the lg item, retained for compatibility; clients adopt `layouts`.

$comment: Per-subtype config shapes live in $defs and are selected via the top-level oneOf below. dataSourceId is not a valid field. A panel is a placement: the `output` kind binds via config.outputId (see OutputConfig) to an Output, which owns the actual data-shaping config (HEL-904); the other kinds (text/markdown/image/divider) carry only their own literal display config.

OutputConfig.description: Config for the `output` panel kind (HEL-904 task 3.6) — a placement of one Output. Everything the five retired bound configs (metric/chart/table/collection/timeline) used to carry (fieldMapping, aggregation, chartOptions, columnWidths/density/columnOrder, timelineOptions, metricId, label/unit) now lives on the Output itself (see schemas/outputs/), not on the placement. Tolerant read: an absent/empty outputId decodes to the empty-string sentinel rather than a validation error; the server still 400s an outputId-less output panel at create/update time. `controls` (HEL-1189) is the author-configured date-range/dropdown/numeric-range/text control list that parameterizes the read (leaf 2 of HEL-915); absent/empty decodes to an empty list.

OutputControlConfig.description: One author-configured control on an `output` panel (HEL-1189 design.md D2). `id` is client-generated (UUID v4) at add time — the server persists it verbatim, never mints or rewrites it. `defaultValue`'s JSON shape is fixed per `kind`: a single string for `text`/`dropdown`; `{"min", "max"}` (each nullable) for `numeric-range`; `{"from", "to"}` (each nullable, ISO-8601 date strings) for `date-range`. Never server-validated, like FormFieldConfig.initialValue.

column.description: The bound Output schema column name. Validated against HEL-1188's filter-capability contract only when this entry is new or its column/kind changed from the persisted entry with the same id (design.md D4) — an untouched, currently-orphaned entry is never re-validated on an unrelated save.

defaultValue.description: Author-supplied default value, shape fixed per kind (see above). Omitted entirely when unset.

orphaned.description: HEL-1189 design.md D5 — read-time-only classification: true iff this control's bound `column` is absent from the Output's CURRENT declared schema, or present but no longer eligible for this control's `kind` per the current filter-capability contract. Never persisted, never accepted on write (a create/update patch carrying this key is rejected — OutputControlConfig's closed key set does not include it). Present only on responses from the panel-READ path (`GET /api/dashboards/:id/panels`) that has actually computed live orphan status; omitted entirely from create/update echo responses and every other OutputControlConfig producer.

caption.description: Optional static caption rendered as a strip beneath the image (HEL-318). Absent leaves it unchanged on PATCH; null/empty/whitespace clears it. Omitted from the response config when unset.

FormConfig.description: Config for the `form` panel kind (HEL-1083) — a panel that writes rows into a `dataset`-kind data source rather than reading a materialized Output. `fields` is an ordered list; order is preserved across persistence and every read. `control` is a presentation vocabulary deliberately orthogonal to the dataset's own declared field type — a form field never re-declares its own data type.

sourceField.description: The dataset field this entry writes to, by name (design.md D3) — the dataset's declared schema remains the single authoritative source of the field's type/required-ness/write-time default.

required.description: Tighten-only (design.md D3a): absent inherits the dataset declaration, true adds a form-level requirement. false is rejected as malformed.

initialValue.description: Prefill only — seeds the control before first input and never changes what is stored for an omitted field. When present and not null, must be a valid value of the bound dataset field's declared type (HEL-1084 design.md D1(e)).

step.description: Valid only alongside control: number. Superseded as the counter discriminator by HEL-1089 — a counter is now its own control value (control: counter), not control: number carrying step.

options.description: Required when control is select: a non-empty array of TYPED values, each a valid value of the bound dataset field's declared type (HEL-1084 design.md D1(d)/D3) — e.g. [1, 2, 3] for an integer field, ["a", "b"] for a string field.

FormSubmitConfig.description: A form's submit behaviour (design.md D4). writeMode is fixed to `append` — `replace` is meaningful to the dataset write API but not to a form submit, and is rejected rather than silently coerced.
